statement.objects_and_definitions: Exponential family dν_θ/dξ(x)=exp(θx−b(θ)), with mean μ=b′(θ) and d(μ,λ)=KL(ν_μ,ν_λ); S is the set of mean vectors with a unique best arm; Alt(μ)={λ∈S:argmax λ≠argmax μ}; Σ_K is the probability simplex; T*(μ)^{-1}=sup_{w∈Σ_K} inf_{λ∈Alt(μ)}Σ_a w_a d(μ_a,λ_a). kl is Bernoulli KL.
statement.parameter_domains: K≥2; 0<δ<1/2; μ has a unique best arm.
statement.quantifiers_and_randomness: An expected sample lower bound holds for every δ-PAC algorithm and every μ∈S; if Eτ is not finite, the lower bound holds trivially.
